jobs_results.title: Brand Marketing Intern
jobs_results.description:
Position Overview
We are looking for a proactive and organized Marketing Activation Intern to support the execution of offline marketing activations, events, branding initiatives, and marketing production. The role will involve extensive vendor coordination, negotiation, budgeting, printing and production management, along with on-ground event execution.
Key Responsibilities
● Coordinate with vendors, agencies, production partners, and event teams for marketing activations and events.
● Manage printing, branding, promotional materials, production, logistics, and event setups.


● Source vendors, obtain quotations, compare costs, and support vendor negotiations and commercial discussions.


● Maintain activation budgets, expense trackers, timelines, quotations, and MIS using MS Excel.


● Coordinate with internal teams including Marketing, Sales, Finance, and Logistics to ensure timely execution.


● Follow up with vendors and stakeholders to ensure quality, timelines, and deliverables are met.


● Support offline brand activations, events, conferences, CMEs, RTMs, and other marketing initiatives, including on-ground execution.


● Assist in managing multiple activations simultaneously and resolving execution-related issues.


required Skills
● Good vendor coordination and management skills.
● Good communication and interpersonal skills.


● Strong knowledge of MS Excel and data tracking.


● Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.


● Attention to detail and ability to work under pressure.


● Basic understanding of event production, branding, printing, logistics, and marketing activations is an advantage.


Eligibility
● Bachelor’s degree or pursuing a degree in BMM, Mass Media, Marketing, Event Management, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field.
● Freshers are welcome to apply.


● Prior internship or exposure to event management, vendor coordination, marketing activations, or production will be preferred.


● Willingness to travel and participate in on-ground events and activations


Stipend - 8,000 - 10,000


NOTE- 


Apply only if you can join immediately.Have your own LaptopYou are from Navi Mumbai or ready to relocate to Navi Mumbai

jobs_results.title: Digital Marketing Intern
jobs_results.description:
Padviram Private Limited is looking for enthusiastic, creative, and career-focused candidates for the position of **Digital Marketing Intern**. This internship is designed for students, freshers, and aspiring digital marketers who want to gain practical industry experience and develop job-ready skills. The selected candidates will get an opportunity to work on real-time digital marketing activities under professional guidance.



During the internship, candidates will be involved in **Social Media Marketing, Content Creation, SEO, Keyword Research, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Lead Generation, Website Promotion, Email Marketing, and Digital Campaign Management**. Interns will also learn how to create engaging social media content, support advertising campaigns, monitor campaign performance, conduct competitor research, and prepare basic marketing reports.



This role provides hands-on exposure to **Google and Meta platforms** along with practical experience in handling digital marketing projects. Candidates will have opportunities to improve their communication, creativity, analytical thinking, and marketing skills.



The internship is suitable for candidates pursuing or recently completing **BBA, BCA, B.Com, MBA, MCA, Digital Marketing, or related courses**. Candidates with basic knowledge of Canva, Excel, social media platforms, or digital marketing will have an added advantage.



Successful interns may receive an **Internship Certificate** and, based on performance and available opportunities, may be considered for further career or placement opportunities with Padviram.

jobs_results.title: Hiring Interns for Content Creation
jobs_results.description:
Company Description Mojo Vibe is a BBQ-focused brand built around the idea that cookouts are about connection, shared stories, and memorable experiences. The company is dedicated to creating feel-good moments where great food and a relaxed atmosphere come together. Mojo Vibe emphasizes sustainable practices, ensuring that each grill session is enjoyable and environmentally responsible. With a grill at the center and bold flavors in every bite, the brand aims to make every gathering unforgettable. At Mojo Vibe, it’s not just a BBQ; it’s a vibe that brings people together.
Role Description This is a contract, on-site role based in Mumbai for interns focused on content creation. Interns will assist in developing engaging written and visual content for social media, websites, meta and google that reflect Mojo Vibe’s brand personality and values. Day-to-day tasks may include brainstorming content ideas, drafting posts and captions, capturing photos or short videos during events or BBQ sessions, and collaborating with the marketing team to maintain a consistent brand voice. Interns will also support in basic editing, scheduling content, and monitoring audience interactions to help grow community engagement. The role offers hands-on experience in content creation within a lifestyle and food-oriented brand environment.
Qualifications
 
Ability to create clear, engaging written content for social media, blogs, and promotional materials.Basic skills in photography or videography and familiarity with creating short-form visual content.Interest in branding, digital marketing, and storytelling for lifestyle or food-related topics.Attention to detail in editing, proofreading, and organizing content assets.Comfort working on-site in Mumbai during events, BBQ sessions, and content shoots.Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.Enthusiasm for learning, creativity, and a proactive approach to trying new content ideas.Currently pursuing or recently completed studies in Media, Communications, Marketing, Design, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.
